What will be the average number of mobile phones sold by all the show rooms in the year 2020 ?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Average = (Sum of the number of phones sold by all showrooms) ÷ (Number of showrooms)

**Calculation:**

Step 1: Calculate the sum of the number of phones sold by all showrooms in 2020.

⇒ Sum = 420 + 430 + 410 + 440 + 400 + 420 = 2520

Step 2: Divide the sum by the number of showrooms (6).

⇒ Average = 2520 ÷ 6 = 420

**∴ The average number of mobile phones sold by all showrooms in the year 2020 is 420.**
